label: The Henchperson
summary: A henchperson with a purple jumpsuit, a ray gun and a surprising amount of common sense.

character.name: Gus Pemberton
character.description: A henchperson who answered a job ad that said 'exciting opportunities in a fast-paced environment'. He has been blasted through four walls and still thinks of it as a good job.
goals: Make it to retirement in one piece
abilities: Knows every corridor of the lair
